paper_title: A star-shaped oligothiophene end-capped with alkyl cyanoacetate groups for solution-processed organic solar cells

knowledge_points.content: S(TPA-3T-CA) is a star-shaped donor-acceptor molecule consisting of a triphenylamine (TPA) core, three terthiophene (3T) arms, and 2-ethylhexyl cyanoacetate (CA) acceptor end groups.
knowledge_points.evidence: Here we design and synthesize a star-shaped, donor–acceptor molecule (S(TPA-3T-CA)) with TPA as a core, oligothiophene as arms, and alkyl CA as acceptor end groups.

knowledge_points.content: The synthesis of S(TPA-3T-CA) involves a Suzuki coupling reaction to form the aldehyde-functionalized intermediate S(TPA-3T-CHO), followed by a condensation reaction with 2-ethylhexyl cyanoacetate.
knowledge_points.evidence: The intermediate compound S(TPA-3TCHO) was synthesized through Suzuki coupling reaction... A straightforward reaction of S(TPA-3T-CHO) with 2-ethylhexyl cyanoacetate afforded S(TPA-3T-CA).

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of alkyl cyanoacetate (CA) end groups in S(TPA-3T-CA) simultaneously induces intramolecular charge-transfer (ICT) to broaden absorption and improves solubility due to the attached 2-ethylhexyl chains.
knowledge_points.evidence: Alkyl cyanoacetate (CA) is a kind of electron withdrawing group with both cyano moiety and alkyl chain which can simultaneously induce ICT and improve solubility.

knowledge_points.content: S(TPA-3T-CA) exhibits a high molar extinction coefficient of 7.3 x 10^4 L mol^-1 cm^-1 at 494 nm in dichloromethane solution.
knowledge_points.evidence: S(TPA-3T-CA) in solution exhibits strong absorption; the extinction coefficient is as large as 7.3 x 10^4 L mol^-1 cm^-1 (at 494 nm).

knowledge_points.content: The optical bandgap of S(TPA-3T-CA) estimated from the film absorption edge is 1.95 eV, which is comparable to the bandgap of regioregular poly(3-hexylthiophene) (P3HT).
knowledge_points.evidence: The optical band gap estimated from the absorption edge of the thin film is 1.95 eV, similar to that of the widely used electron donor regioregular poly(3-hexylthiophene) (P3HT).

knowledge_points.content: S(TPA-3T-CA) possesses a HOMO energy level of -5.28 eV and a LUMO energy level of -3.43 eV, determined via cyclic voltammetry.
knowledge_points.evidence: The HOMO and LUMO energies were estimated to be -5.28 and -3.43 eV from the onset oxidation and reduction potentials, respectively

knowledge_points.content: The pristine film of S(TPA-3T-CA) demonstrates a relatively high hole mobility of 1.5 x 10^-3 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 as measured by the space charge limited current (SCLC) method.
knowledge_points.evidence: A relatively high hole mobility of 1.5 x 10^-3 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 was obtained from the pristine S(TPA-3T-CA) film.

knowledge_points.content: Organic solar cells using S(TPA-3T-CA):PC71BM at a 1:2 weight ratio achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 3.60%, with a VOC of 0.88 V, JSC of 7.30 mA cm^-2, and a fill factor (FF) of 0.56.
knowledge_points.evidence: The BHJ blend at a donor/acceptor weight ratio of 1 : 2 gives the best performance: VOC, JSC, FF and PCE reaches 0.88 V, 7.30 mA cm^-2, 0.56 and 3.60%, respectively

knowledge_points.content: The incident photon to converted current efficiency (IPCE) spectrum of the S(TPA-3T-CA):PC71BM (1:2) device shows a maximum value of 52% at 505 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: This blend film shows broad IPCE spectra from 300 to 700 nm with a maximum of 52% at 505 nm

knowledge_points.content: AFM and TEM characterization of the S(TPA-3T-CA):PC71BM (1:2) blend film reveals nanoscale phase separation with domain sizes of approximately 30-40 nm and an RMS roughness of 1.55 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: The film exhibits a good interpenetrating network and has a relatively smooth surface with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 1.55 nm. The domain sizes estimated by cross-section profiles are about 30-40 nm

knowledge_points.content: S(TPA-3T-CA) exhibits high thermal stability with a decomposition temperature (5% weight loss) of 350 °C under nitrogen.
knowledge_points.evidence: This star-shaped molecule exhibits good thermal stability with decomposition temperature (5% weight loss) at 350 °C in nitrogen

knowledge_points.content: The S(TPA-3T-CA):PC71BM based solar cells achieve their peak performance of 3.60% PCE without the need for any post-treatments like thermal or solvent annealing.
knowledge_points.evidence: Solution-processed BHJ OSCs based on S(TPA-3TCA):PC71BM without any post-treatments exhibit PCEs as high as 3.60%
